intro.novel: The manuscript for an editor or an e-reader, the story bible, a backup of everything.
intro.game: The script and the document for the team, the formats for Twine, Ink and developers, a backup of everything.

page.empty: There is nothing to export yet: write a scene and come back.
page.backupNote: A backup opens again as a new project, next to the ones you have: nothing is overwritten.
page.pdfHint: It opens in a new tab: in the print dialog choose Save as PDF.

docx.label: DOCX
docx.hint: For Word and LibreOffice, with real styles: whoever receives it can restyle it.

pdf.label: PDF
pdf.hint: Laid out and ready to print or to send.

epub.label: EPUB
epub.hint: To read it on an e-reader, a tablet or a phone.

hint.novel: Premise, fabula, setting, characters, world, events and structure in one document.
hint.game: The whole story bible, with scene codes, quests, variables, the branch table and the characters' voices.

json.label: JSON for developers
json.hint: Scenes, lines, choices, conditions and effects in a documented format, with its schema.

twee.label: Twee 3, for Twine
twee.hint: For Twine 2.6 and Tweego, in Harlowe 3 or SugarCube 2: it plays from the start scene to the endings.

ink.label: Ink
ink.hint: For Inky and the ink engine in Unity, Unreal or on the web.

csv.label: Voice-over script, CSV
csv.hint: One row per line, with ids that never change, for Excel and Google Sheets.

backup.label: Full backup, ZIP
backup.hint: The whole project, with the trash, the revisions and the images.

documentPdf.label: {name}, PDF
documentPdf.hint: The same document, laid out and ready to print or to send.

options.titlePageHint: Title, author and words, rounded to the hundred.
options.separator: Between one scene and the next

manuscript.label: Standard manuscript
manuscript.docx: A4, Courier New 12, 30 lines of 60 characters, numbered pages: the Italian publishers' standard page.
manuscript.pdf: A4, Courier New 12, 30 lines of 60 characters, numbered pages: the Italian publishers' standard page.

book.label: Book
book.docx: The manuscript typeface at 11 points, justified, with first-line indents, on A5 pages.
book.pdf: The manuscript typeface at 11 points, justified, with first-line indents, on A5 pages.

options.imagesHint: Each character's portrait and the first image of groups, locations and objects.

delimiters.semicolon: Semicolon, for spreadsheets set to Italian or other European languages

options.speaker: Speaker
options.coverHint: Optional: a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, best upright and at least 1,600 pixels tall.

summary.label: In the file
summary.empty: No scene with text matches these options.
summary.noScenes: No scenes yet: the flow is empty.

actions.schema: Download the JSON schema of the format

flow.noStart: No start scene: it starts from the first scene of the {manuscript}.
flow.problems: The flow has {n} problem: the file is exported anyway. | The flow has {n} problems: the file is exported anyway.

history.title: Last exports
history.empty: No exports yet: every file you export will appear here, with its date.

errors.notBackup: This file cannot be imported: it takes a Dramatis backup (.dramatis.zip), a Word document (.docx) or a Markdown or text file.
errors.version: This backup comes from a newer version of Dramatis.
errors.invalid: The backup is damaged: some of its data cannot be read.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large to import.
errors.empty: The manuscript is empty: there is no text to import.
errors.encoding: I cannot read the text of this file: save it again as UTF-8 text and try again.
errors.busy: Another import is still running: wait for it to finish and try again.

print.title: Print preview
print.hint: In the print dialog choose Save as PDF: the pages are already set up.

doc.noStart: None: the story starts from the first scene of the {manuscript}
doc.clean: No problems: every scene can be reached from the start and every path leads to an ending.
doc.brokenTargets: Choices to scenes in the trash
doc.trashedVariables: Choices with variables in the trash

pageNumbers.missing: In this browser the pages of the PDF come out without numbers. To have them, open the preview in Chrome or Edge, or export as DOCX.
pageNumbers.missingBook: In this browser the pages of the PDF come out without numbers: in the print dialog, check that the paper is A5. For the exact layout, open the preview in Chrome or Edge, or export as DOCX.
